disorder-name.detail: Psychosis spectrum disorders; combined group of PNC psychosis spectrum youth (defined by GOASSESS/SIPS/PRIME Screen-Revised criteria) and Pitt first episode psychosis (FEP) youth from a Conte Center study
disorder-name.supporting_text: "622 typically developing control youths, 194 youths with psychosis spectrum disorders, and 246 youths with other psychopathology"

dataset-of-origin.detail: 162 subjects from the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) and 32 subjects from a single-site Conte Center study at the University of Pittsburgh (Pitt)
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Three data sets were acquired at the University of Pittsburgh and one at the University of Pennsylvania"
dataset-of-origin.location: Jalbrzikowski2019.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L35; Table 1, L59-L60

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD computed from two sub-cohorts: PNC (N=162, mean=16.0, SD=2.9) and Pitt (N=32, mean=20.8, SD=3.1). Min/max not reported separately for the psychosis spectrum group; overall study age range is 10-25 years.
age.supporting_text: Table 1: Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort Psychosis Spectrum N=162, Mean=16.0, SD=2.9; Pitt Psychosis Spectrum N=32, Mean=20.8, SD=3.1

sex.detail: Combined from PNC (Male=75, Female=87) and Pitt (Male=19, Female=13). Percentages calculated from total N=194.
sex.supporting_text: Table 1: Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort Psychosis Spectrum Male/Female=75/87; Pitt Psychosis Spectrum Male/Female=19/13

disorder-name.detail: Non-psychotic psychopathology; participants who met DSM-IV criteria for non-psychotic psychiatric disorders, assessed via GOASSESS in the PNC
disorder-name.supporting_text: "another group of participants who met DSM-IV criteria for non-psychotic psychopathology was created"

dataset-of-origin.detail: All 246 subjects from the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC)
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: Table 1: Only the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort contributed subjects to the Other Psychopathology Group (N=246)

age.detail: Single cohort (PNC); min/max not reported separately for the other psychopathology group; PNC cohort age range is 10-22 years.
